newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea to lease pier operations to private sector.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea to lease pier operations to private sector.

text.p: South Korea's Ministry of Maritime Affairs said on Wednesday the government planned to lease operations at major piers to private interests from next year.
A ministry statement said the government will designate companies to operate all pier facilities including yards and storage, which are currently under the state monopoly.
The basic lease period will be three years and the government will decide on the renewal of contracts after reviewing performance for the contracted period, it said.
The statement said the government expected private operators to improve efficiency, and bring down the distribution costs for local manufacturers.
The nation's two largest ports of Pusan and Inchon will be the first target for the private operations, it said.
It said further details had yet to be finalised.
